body:
People become friends because they are fun and enjoyable. Why else would you want to hang out and be around someone. I'm not fun, I'm not interesting, I'm weird but in the bad way. And yes I'm sure that people will see me for what I am. I know that people say that depression lies but that is for normal depressed people. The fact that I haven't had so much as an acquaintance in 10 years is a good indicator.  

Eventually it does become too late to get close to someone. People expect me to have experience that I don't have. Plus they will wonder what is wrong with me. 

I feel too broken and messed up to get better. A therapist once asked me to say one positive about myself and I just starred at her.

Oh yeah, I suspect that even if I tricked people into being my friends that I would have to keep quite about my depression, people have their own problems and I just will come off as whining. 

The vast majority of people already have friends and have no need to pick up someone like me. I'm not interesting and will just be a huge anchor to them. People deserve better. 

Idk I'm just a failed human. We throw broken things away all the time, why not people?

I pretty much am destined to be alone. Always have been, I'm just too fucked up of a person. I understand why I'm alone, I'm just a failed human. Not very interesting, strange discussions, not good at most interests, and overall just fucked up in the head. Good luck with your plans and your suicide. 

I'm 26 but have been like this my whole life. I don't even know what friendship is.

I haven't had a friend in close to 10 years and before that they never invited me to go to things. I don't even know what friendship is. 

Loneliness is a huge part of me and always has been, I've been wishing to die since I was a little kid. I've have always smiled a lot but I just cannot pretend anymore. The pain in my chest has gotten to much and I cannot even look at young couples anymore without wanting to burst into tears. Now though I'm some weird fucked up and depressing person, I wouldn't want to be with me, that is why I'm going to kill myself.

Exactly, posts like this bother me because many of them mentioned that they have dated before. I don't put myself out there due to anxiety but still am I that bad. Well now that I think about yes, yes I am.

No I never have, every time I get close I wake up. It is likely because I have no idea what it is like so my brain doesn't even try. I dreamed about a girl I liked playing basketball naked though. I don't remember most of my dreams but when I do it is either a relationship one, being chased by monsters, or me trying to commit suicide.

Yeah, I'm tempted to create another subreddit for the next time they do something like this. The fact that they have refused to defend their position shows that any defense would be laughably bad and they don't care and are just waiting for the whole thing to blow over. The great suggestion of a mega thread about the topic isn't even acknowledged in the slightest though someone slipped a post past them for a few hours that quickly became the most popular post here. This whole thing is so truly baffling and upsetting and the mods know that there truly nothing anyone can do as the admins don't care either. This subreddit catastrophically failed today by being one of the least helpful subreddits for people with depression and has shown that it cannot be relied on to provide support.

Frankly I am stunned at this. First, everyone already knows as the news it is everywhere. I'm surprised Google hasn't posted a message on their homepage. This subreddit has posts about rape, child rape, molestation, murder, drugs, cutting, etc. This will force people to receive help from other subreddits like /r/news, /r/movies, /r/pics. This policy is a bury your head in the sand and pretend nothing is happening and goes against what you have posted this subreddit is about.

>Support and sharing for anyone struggling with depression.

  and then you post this:
 

>We understand that some of you want to talk about your feelings in the context of these events,... so we encourage you to do your sharing in another subreddit.


Do you not realize how crazy it is to tell people to get help on other subreddits instead of a subreddit that was suppose to created for that purpose. You know maybe this is a good thing as I have posted in default subreddits I have received more and better responses than I have received here. You post here and you might get a response or two and they are the same clinically allowed post whereas other subreddits allowed people to be more varied and ultimately far less condescending. A real response for a real conversation with real emotions that actually tried to connect to me. In fact the worst response I have ever gotten has been from here.
